fields.description: Issue features editorials and local reporting on Dade County and Miami-area politics and governance, including arguments that legalized gambling and off-track betting are likely in Dade County and discussion of the Crime Commission’s criticisms of local officials. Coverage includes concerns about public control of water rates, police handling of minor offenses and detainees, and county court/judicial ethics matters (including excerpts from a court filing in the Jacobson divorce case). Additional items address emergency access to doctors and a death following delayed treatment at Jackson Memorial Hospital, transportation and bus service disputes, and plans to expand and dredge Miami-area dock and harbor facilities (including Dinner Key).
